pluginMetaData.name: ASTM E1381 Transmission Mode (bitdreamit)
pluginMetaData.author: Bit Dream IT
pluginMetaData.description: ASTM E1381-02 lower-layer transmission framing protocol - client side. Provides the settings panel (Frame Settings, Validation Settings, Connection Settings, Mode) used by channel authors when configuring an ASTM E1381 destination connector. Also provides the client-side TransmissionModeClientProvider that drives the ENQ -> ACK -> frames -> EOT send flow.
